thinkKnow.heading: Things you should know
subPara:
1. Who Can Refer? (Hint: That’s YOU!)

  • Anyone with a DigitalDSA account – whether you're a loan agent, financial consultant, or just someone who loves helping others (and making extra cash while at it).
  • No need to be a finance wizard; just share your referral link and let us do the magic.

2. What Counts as a “Successful Referral”?

  • Your friend (or customer) must apply for a loan through your unique referral link.
  • The loan must be sanctioned and disbursed – no ghost applications, no “just checking” clicks.
  • Once that sweet, sweet loan amount lands in their account, your reward is locked in.

3. How Do You Get Paid? (The Juicy Part!)

  • You’ll receive your reward after the lender confirms the loan disbursement (typically within 30–60 days).
  • Payments will be directly transferred to your bank or UPI wallet – no complicated redemptions or shady points system.
  • The more referrals, the fatter your payout – no limits!

4. Things That Won’t Fly (No Funny Business!)

  • No fake referrals – we check! Misusing the program (spam referrals, self-referrals, or shady practices) will get you banned.
  • No cold-calling random strangers. Your referrals should be people genuinely looking for a loan. (Uncles, colleagues, besties – all fair game! 🙌)
  • No shortcuts. Only referrals made through your unique link will count.

5. Why Should You Care? (Because Money!)

  • You’re helping people find the best loan options – and getting rewarded for it. Win-win!
  • No need to sell anything – just share your link and let us handle the rest.
  • Unlimited earning potential – bring in 10 referrals? 50? 100? You get paid for every single successful one.
Start Referring & Earning Now!
